fullDescription: A cinematic, dark-themed interactive landing page with a minimalist aesthetic and a primary focus on a fluid, purple 'ghost cursor' trail. Features bold, editorial-style typography (Cabinet Grotesk) paired with a clean sans-serif (Satoshi). The design utilizes high-contrast deep blacks (#050505) and vibrant lavender accents (#B19EEF) to create a moody, immersive environment suitable for creative studios, premium SaaS, AI portfolios, and high-end digital experiences. Key elements include interactive shaders, bento-grid features, and large-scale typography gradients.
prompt:
## Resumo
Design a high-end, immersive 'Phantom' landing page featuring a deep black background, massive typography, and a fluid-smoke cursor interaction. The UI should be minimal but impactful, emphasizing motion, ethereal glows, and precise spacing to create a cinematic digital atmosphere.

## Estilo Visual
Set the foundation with a background color of #050505 and text color #FFFFFF. Primary Accent: #B19EEF. Typography: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Weights: 700, 800) for headers with tight tracking (-0.05em). Use 'Satoshi' (Weights: 400, 500) for body text with line-height 1.6. Navigation and UI elements should use a semi-transparent border (white at 10% opacity) and 12px to 24px border radii. Implement a global 'selection' style with background #B19EEF and text #000000. For glows, use a radial-gradient of #B19EEF at 10% opacity with a blur of 120px. Hover states for interactive elements should include a box-shadow glow: 0 0 20px rgba(177, 158, 239, 0.4).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Fixed top navigation, height 80px, background #050505 with a 1px border-bottom (white/5%). Max-width 1280px. Left side: logo (8x8 rounded-full #B19EEF dot + 'PHANTOM' text in bold). Center: Navigation links ('Experience', 'Technology', 'About') in text-white/60, changing to white on hover. Right side: 'Request Access' button with a rounded-full pill shape and white/10% border.

### Hero Section
Full viewport height (100vh), centered flex column. Background features a large blurred #B19EEF circle (600px) at 10% opacity behind the text. Top: A badge element with #B19EEF dot, white/5% background, and 'INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE' text in 10px tracking-widest. Main: Title 'PHANTOM' in Cabinet Grotesk, font-size 12rem (responsive), using a linear gradient from white to white/40%. Below: Description in Satoshi, font-size 24px, color white/50%, max-width 600px. Bottom: Two buttons—Primary (#B19EEF background, black text, bold) and Secondary (border-white/10%, ghost style).

### Features Grid
Three-column grid layout with 32px gaps. Each card has a background of white/2% and a white/10% border. Border-radius: 24px. Padding: 32px. Card icons are 48x48px with a #B19EEF/10% background and #B19EEF icon. Titles are 24px bold; descriptions are white/40% with high readability. Hover effect: change border to #B19EEF/30% and scale slightly.

### CTA Section
High-impact centered section. Heading: 'Ready to enter the void?' in 64px bold. Subtext: white/40%, max-width 3xl. Button: 'Join the Collective' in a large pill shape, white background, black text. Include a background glow (#B19EEF) behind the button that intensifies from 20% to 40% opacity on hover.

### Footer
Horizontal layout, border-top white/5%, padding 48px. Left: 'PHANTOM STUDIO' with white circle icon (50% opacity). Center: Policy links in white/30%. Right: Copyright text in white/20%.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Ghost Cursor Shader — A fluid dynamics-based cursor trail that follows mouse movement with inertia and bloom.
Implement a full-screen canvas with a fragment shader using FBM (Fractal Brownian Motion) and Navier-Stokes principles. Create a trail of 20 points that follow the mouse coordinate. The trail color must be #B19EEF. Use a 'blob' function that calculates alpha based on smoke density (pow(smoke, 2.5)). Add a brightness uniform of 1.2 to create a 'bloom' effect. When the mouse stops, the trail should fade out over 1000ms using a linear opacity decay.

### Gradient Heading — Large editorial heading with vertical depth.
Apply 'text-transparent' and 'bg-clip-text' to the H1. Background gradient: linear-to-bottom starting at #FFFFFF and ending at #FFFFFF with 40% opacity. This creates a cinematic lighting effect on the font.

style.description: The style is 'Ethereal Minimalist' characterized by a dark-mode palette, soft purple glows, and premium typography. It relies on smooth transitions and a custom Three.js/Shader-based cursor effect that leaves a smoky trail. Typography uses heavy font weights for titles and light, airy weights for body text.
